tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the Swarmnest directory of AI agent tools: MCP servers, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, coding agents, browser automation, vector databases, web scraping, search, speech and text-to-speech APIs, data sources and more (thousands of hand-checked entries in 160+ categories). Keyword search over name

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get the full Swarmnest directory record for one tool by its slug (from search_directory results): name, description, category, vendor URL, docs URL, auth, pricing, operating systems, open-source flag, last link check and the canonical swarmnest.ai URL. Unknown slugs return close matches.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every Swarmnest directory category with its slug, name, short description, entry count and group (e.g. Agent Building, AI Models, Data & Search). Use the slugs as the category filter in search_directory. Optionally limit to one group.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the Swarmnest catalog of Agent Skills: SKILL.md skills, plugin bundles, Cursor rules, AGENTS.md templates and prompt packs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and other agents. Keyword search over title, summary and category; filter by skill category, format, platform o

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one Agent Skill by slug (from search_skills): summary, format, declared platforms, install steps per platform, scripts/network/credentials labels, license, author, source URL and canonical swarmnest.ai URL. Third-party: review the source before installing.

tools.name: list_marketplace_products
tools.description: List the agent skill packs, workflows and bundles sold in the Swarmnest Marketplace (US only), with name, type, summary, price in USD, what each bundle includes, the product page URL and the checkout URL.
